20918d3a81f549791c2b.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

0f8e4424371d40bca636.speaker: granny
0f8e4424371d40bca636.text: You lost to a dog? Fine. Dogs are fast. Show me your guard.
0f8e4424371d40bca636.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

c9365a08fbadeed72029.speaker: granny
c9365a08fbadeed72029.text: Hands up. Chin down. Everything else is details.
c9365a08fbadeed72029.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

ac8a96cc8048ca89af79.speaker: granny
ac8a96cc8048ca89af79.text: Hit the bag like it owes you Scrip.
ac8a96cc8048ca89af79.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

0897657d18c5c3ac553c.speaker: granny
0897657d18c5c3ac553c.text: I've seen faster feet on a filing cabinet.
0897657d18c5c3ac553c.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

74263999019a5d7e2d48.speaker: granny
74263999019a5d7e2d48.text: Breathe out when you throw. Breathe in when you're winning.
74263999019a5d7e2d48.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

559679b8f5764b766006.speaker: granny
559679b8f5764b766006.text: That bag's been here longer than you. Show it some respect. Then show it your elbow.
559679b8f5764b766006.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

f2e660452893211985a9.speaker: granny
f2e660452893211985a9.text: You again. Good. The bag missed you.
f2e660452893211985a9.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

99078266bea151ea7783.speaker: granny
99078266bea151ea7783.text: Gloves on, mouth shut, eyes open. What do you need?
99078266bea151ea7783.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

78e25de8d26da42e14e1.speaker: granny
78e25de8d26da42e14e1.text: I was knocking out longshoremen in this cannery before your parents were spawned. Talk.
78e25de8d26da42e14e1.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

4acf050d1b323bb5c359.speaker: granny
4acf050d1b323bb5c359.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

65b351936d9c76a74287.speaker: granny
65b351936d9c76a74287.text: Was that a punch or a rumor?
65b351936d9c76a74287.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

1f80e241cc5097126637.speaker: granny
1f80e241cc5097126637.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

9f16412e6f1c47636b58.speaker: granny
9f16412e6f1c47636b58.text: First day? Then here's the first lesson: everybody gets hit. Champions get up.
9f16412e6f1c47636b58.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

c36bdd75ececefb2a094.speaker: granny
c36bdd75ececefb2a094.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

1dd144e4406049f5fdd5.speaker: granny
1dd144e4406049f5fdd5.text: . I've seen worse. I've coached worse. Bag. Now.
1dd144e4406049f5fdd5.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

ca0f925e7bf164f41d3e.speaker: granny
ca0f925e7bf164f41d3e.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

b388baa3f4c3c246de41.speaker: granny
b388baa3f4c3c246de41.text: got you. That eel doesn't care how you feel. Neither do I. Again.
b388baa3f4c3c246de41.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

c06529b298c953f822bb.speaker: granny
c06529b298c953f822bb.text: You made the main card. Now make it to the end of it.
c06529b298c953f822bb.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

ae7b5b1dd2e85b301470.speaker: granny
ae7b5b1dd2e85b301470.text: One fight from the belt and you blinked. I saw it. Everybody saw it. Don't blink.
ae7b5b1dd2e85b301470.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

a3d5239268d348232175.speaker: granny
a3d5239268d348232175.text: The Commissioner doesn't fight fair. Neither should your footwork.
a3d5239268d348232175.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

679554e104fc93ccf5a9.speaker: granny
679554e104fc93ccf5a9.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

50e99f0e3fd33c450746.speaker: granny
50e99f0e3fd33c450746.text: . Don't let it go to your head. Let it go to your hands.
50e99f0e3fd33c450746.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

a02ad9f612af18f064d6.speaker: granny
a02ad9f612af18f064d6.text: Good night's work. Ice your knuckles, then hit the bag.
a02ad9f612af18f064d6.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

89d4e5c89a89fbc0b50c.speaker: granny
89d4e5c89a89fbc0b50c.text: Champion. Hmph. Now the hard part: staying one.
89d4e5c89a89fbc0b50c.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

8b4462911463b31488eb.speaker: granny
8b4462911463b31488eb.text: You took the belt off that turtle. My knees haven't been this happy since 1973.
8b4462911463b31488eb.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

c1c4883642e4f70cb7ad.speaker: granny
c1c4883642e4f70cb7ad.text: Thirty seconds. Make the bag regret being a bag.
c1c4883642e4f70cb7ad.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

d7b376107a160858d183.speaker: granny
d7b376107a160858d183.text: That's a warm-up score. Go again.
d7b376107a160858d183.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

78ed2d0c1a45f6eccadb.speaker: granny
78ed2d0c1a45f6eccadb.text: Now we're talking. Hands back to the face after every shot.
78ed2d0c1a45f6eccadb.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

507c27487db540064ed6.speaker: granny
507c27487db540064ed6.text: That'S a score. The bag's filing a complaint.
507c27487db540064ed6.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

eb8f319a0d69f5ae9fa8.speaker: granny
eb8f319a0d69f5ae9fa8.text: Bag three's got a secret. Always has. Hit it with something charged and see what swings loose.
eb8f319a0d69f5ae9fa8.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

a079528333b15179018b.speaker: granny
a079528333b15179018b.text: Did you just set my bag on fire? ...Do it again.
a079528333b15179018b.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

a51360722803485950be.speaker: granny
a51360722803485950be.text: Now That'S equipment. Don't break it. Break yourself on it.
a51360722803485950be.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

30a199c0914c9109ed11.speaker: granny
30a199c0914c9109ed11.text: Lessons are in the cage. Bring your guard; leave your excuses.
30a199c0914c9109ed11.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

7d6bf3f1eacba6bc6259.speaker: granny
7d6bf3f1eacba6bc6259.text: Something's been sleeping under those stairs. Hit the heavy bag hard enough and it'll wake up.
7d6bf3f1eacba6bc6259.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

869de7611ee91b115eb3.speaker: granny
869de7611ee91b115eb3.text: Somebody finally fixed the lights. I could see you losing before. Now I can see it in color.
869de7611ee91b115eb3.instructions: A gruff veteran boxing coach. Warm tough love, crisp practical instructions, dry wit. Natural speech, no shouting.

135e793674deba3d2dbd.speaker: snappington
135e793674deba3d2dbd.text: Sign here. And here. The waiver is mostly decorative.
135e793674deba3d2dbd.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

027f71a3e2334325d667.speaker: snappington
027f71a3e2334325d667.text: The Commission has reviewed your conduct and found it entertaining.
027f71a3e2334325d667.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

18d9bbad423fb11787d1.speaker: snappington
18d9bbad423fb11787d1.text: Title shots are earned. Or purchased. Mostly earned.
18d9bbad423fb11787d1.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

b0c9ec71c997eff0517e.speaker: snappington
b0c9ec71c997eff0517e.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

8db70454dfa7b2983a54.speaker: snappington
8db70454dfa7b2983a54.text: State your business. The Commission bills by the minute.
8db70454dfa7b2983a54.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

cb5e1befae2801d5ddde.speaker: snappington
cb5e1befae2801d5ddde.text: Ah. The applicant. Sit. Do not sit there.
cb5e1befae2801d5ddde.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

2ef43143e7be30921177.speaker: snappington
2ef43143e7be30921177.text: The rulebook is four hundred pages. I wrote it. I remember all of it.
2ef43143e7be30921177.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

8c07b0a7aeb802f043c3.speaker: snappington
8c07b0a7aeb802f043c3.text: The Commission notes the assault. The Commission is unbothered.
8c07b0a7aeb802f043c3.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

86d543743349f09449c0.speaker: snappington
86d543743349f09449c0.text: That will be on your record. In ink.
86d543743349f09449c0.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

4bfaa03eb6b16e0b5c4c.speaker: snappington
4bfaa03eb6b16e0b5c4c.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

bf367e90c85be5c01952.speaker: snappington
bf367e90c85be5c01952.text: A new contender. The Commission will now pretend to be surprised when you win.
bf367e90c85be5c01952.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

26873da34e47b2914b02.speaker: snappington
26873da34e47b2914b02.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

14dc90498eb6d61a4db6.speaker: snappington
14dc90498eb6d61a4db6.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

ae2fe13cd4409d4dfd13.speaker: snappington
ae2fe13cd4409d4dfd13.text: The Commission has filed your loss under 'learning experiences'. It is a thick folder.
ae2fe13cd4409d4dfd13.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

b7abd85fb70c1d8e6690.speaker: snappington
b7abd85fb70c1d8e6690.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

fe0b3bc3630cb87de4d2.speaker: snappington
fe0b3bc3630cb87de4d2.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

38829c2d99c3fe69a2a6.speaker: snappington
38829c2d99c3fe69a2a6.text: You reached my desk and fell at the last signature. The Commission is... almost impressed.
38829c2d99c3fe69a2a6.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

a1be7c2106257da0ddb5.speaker: snappington
a1be7c2106257da0ddb5.text: So close to the belt. The Commission enjoys 'so close'.
a1be7c2106257da0ddb5.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

739d4739ca61983f1df3.speaker: snappington
739d4739ca61983f1df3.text: A boss defeated. The Commission will update your file. Slowly.
739d4739ca61983f1df3.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

a8329d5fd64f569e6409.speaker: snappington
a8329d5fd64f569e6409.text: Your win has been reviewed, stamped and filed. Do it again.
a8329d5fd64f569e6409.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

3e9e2cdf2c7c96d1a170.speaker: snappington
3e9e2cdf2c7c96d1a170.text: The belt is yours. Temporarily. Everything is temporary. Except the rulebook.
3e9e2cdf2c7c96d1a170.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

7b27b327e34ee5b1cc62.speaker: snappington
7b27b327e34ee5b1cc62.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

c813f2b1f89183a69361.speaker: snappington
c813f2b1f89183a69361.text: . The Commission congratulates you and reminds you that rematches are mandatory.
c813f2b1f89183a69361.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

740529a901731179c04c.speaker: snappington
740529a901731179c04c.text: The fight cards haven't come back from the printer. The Commission apologizes for nothing.
740529a901731179c04c.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

d7118afc7f0b086fc74f.speaker: snappington
d7118afc7f0b086fc74f.text: Signed. Witnessed. Notarized. Go and be entertaining.
d7118afc7f0b086fc74f.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

4adc52474dd67f870556.speaker: snappington
4adc52474dd67f870556.text: Purchase recorded. The ledger thanks you. I do not.
4adc52474dd67f870556.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

9aa3a47e20dd3ab8c613.speaker: snappington
9aa3a47e20dd3ab8c613.text: That second cabinet is Commission property. As is everything you can see.
9aa3a47e20dd3ab8c613.instructions: A pompous league commissioner. Measured, officious, dry comic authority.

6de7dc00b4bec47a40ad.speaker: needles
6de7dc00b4bec47a40ad.text: Everything here is natural. Everything. Some of it was natural very recently.
6de7dc00b4bec47a40ad.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

e23a4488f9c1ef73e4b8.speaker: needles
e23a4488f9c1ef73e4b8.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

f9d184fdbb6adb06a280.speaker: needles
f9d184fdbb6adb06a280.text: This one makes your heavy hit harder. Also your hair might fall out. Mostly the first thing.
f9d184fdbb6adb06a280.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

837223be880fcc47dc78.speaker: needles
837223be880fcc47dc78.text: Try the green one! Everyone tries the green one. Once.
837223be880fcc47dc78.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

dbcf9496fbaebb58f50c.speaker: needles
dbcf9496fbaebb58f50c.text: Welcome welcome welcome! Lab coat's clean, I promise. Mostly clean. What can I get you?
dbcf9496fbaebb58f50c.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

64668438b4a6c06d3cd0.speaker: needles
64668438b4a6c06d3cd0.text: You look like a customer! I love customers. I'm sweating because I love you.
64668438b4a6c06d3cd0.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

47008b51dc35b441fe50.speaker: needles
47008b51dc35b441fe50.text: Fresh batch! Labels are optional! Questions are discouraged!
47008b51dc35b441fe50.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

bac83f1db1d5d43ec2a0.speaker: needles
bac83f1db1d5d43ec2a0.text: Ow! That's assault on a licensed professional! The license is pending!
bac83f1db1d5d43ec2a0.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

1ba11fb23721af23a274.speaker: needles
1ba11fb23721af23a274.text: Careful! I'm full of quills and liability!
1ba11fb23721af23a274.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

ac234b1368679ff4b617.speaker: needles
ac234b1368679ff4b617.text: First run? You'll be back. Everybody comes back. Usually thirsty.
ac234b1368679ff4b617.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

c8d11308d110b3397cae.speaker: needles
c8d11308d110b3397cae.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

f7478c27b3386777521e.speaker: needles
f7478c27b3386777521e.text: ? Have you tried more supplements? It's always more supplements.
f7478c27b3386777521e.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

1b230dcd9ea5e79227e3.speaker: needles
1b230dcd9ea5e79227e3.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

2dd2064887648299a57f.speaker: needles
2dd2064887648299a57f.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible. Speak only this phrase; it is part of a longer sentence.

ed1ba392e67767f83804.speaker: needles
ed1ba392e67767f83804.text: Act 2 is where the side effects kick in. Coincidence! Totally.
ed1ba392e67767f83804.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

91b5573bb46c7b3a0c9d.speaker: needles
91b5573bb46c7b3a0c9d.text: So close! Next time take the purple one. Or don't. I'm legally required to say don't.
91b5573bb46c7b3a0c9d.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

ccd105e14fe156f611b1.speaker: needles
ccd105e14fe156f611b1.text: A winner! Winners love my products! Correlation is causation!
ccd105e14fe156f611b1.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

a7e4588d8c1e9ac73352.speaker: needles
a7e4588d8c1e9ac73352.text: Champion! Can I put your face on a label? I can't pay you. I can pay you in labels.
a7e4588d8c1e9ac73352.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

bf7eb74f5b0512f5f78a.speaker: needles
bf7eb74f5b0512f5f78a.text: Pleasure doing business! The fine print is very fine.
bf7eb74f5b0512f5f78a.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

e5ff14ece3d03620ce96.speaker: needles
e5ff14ece3d03620ce96.text: Tonight's menu! Prices are for runs only, the Commission is very strict about that.
e5ff14ece3d03620ce96.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

5865dbfbc746bbf09312.speaker: needles
5865dbfbc746bbf09312.text: Don't touch the dial, it took me a week to find a station that doesn't play news.
5865dbfbc746bbf09312.instructions: An excitable supplement salesman. Slightly nervous, bright, comic sales patter, intelligible.

8b65fa5118a11af16f9a.speaker: doc
8b65fa5118a11af16f9a.instructions: A brisk no-nonsense medic. Calm, clipped, dryly amused.

03cd1a25fd380761889d.speaker: doc
03cd1a25fd380761889d.text: That's not blood, that's Juice. That's worse.
03cd1a25fd380761889d.instructions: A brisk no-nonsense medic. Calm, clipped, dryly amused.

cf8cf2dd9647803081a3.speaker: doc
cf8cf2dd9647803081a3.text: You'll live. That's a medical opinion and a threat.
cf8cf2dd9647803081a3.instructions: A brisk no-nonsense medic. Calm, clipped, dryly amused.

2dacfd7b4386e3b34bfc.speaker: doc
2dacfd7b4386e3b34bfc.text: Eight hands and none of them are for holding yours.
2dacfd7b4386e3b34bfc.instructions: A brisk no-nonsense medic. Calm, clipped, dryly amused.

2bf287b0b0a34ff4d1a6.speaker: doc
2bf287b0b0a34ff4d1a6.text: Sit. Where does it hurt? Don't answer, I can see it.
2bf287b0b0a34ff4d1a6.instructions: A brisk no-nonsense medic. Calm, clipped, dryly amused.

a34f33c99a87031f0c6f.speaker: doc
a34f33c99a87031f0c6f.text: Make it quick, I've got a lamprey with a tooth stuck in a turnbuckle.
a34f33c99a87031f0c6f.instructions: A brisk no-nonsense medic. Calm, clipped, dryly amused.

5526ac7f2648fd3f95cf.speaker: doc
5526ac7f2648fd3f95cf.instructions: A brisk no-nonsense medic. Calm, clipped, dryly amused.

c71937353df9f54bbc31.speaker: doc
c71937353df9f54bbc31.text: I will stitch your mouth shut. I have the thread.
c71937353df9f54bbc31.instructions: A brisk no-nonsense medic. Calm, clipped, dryly amused.

aedc6a85ee6c97d76245.speaker: doc
aedc6a85ee6c97d76245.text: Do that again and I'll prescribe you a nap. A long one.
aedc6a85ee6c97d76245.instructions: A brisk no-nonsense medic. Calm, clipped, dryly amused.

5a3825b63dafc8901ef5.speaker: doc
